notes.title: Small Update
Update 1.0.2
Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
The update 1.0.1 brings the following changes:

 - Decrease new floor unlock costs, you can now unlock more spaces for cheaper prices.
 - The Starter default spawn time now defaults to the lowest possible when building.
 - The machine destroyed sound now only plays when a machine gets destroyed, previously it would be played even if there were no machines destroyed.
 - The Rotate tool icon now matches the rotation orientation that the machine does when rotating, it was inverted previously.
 - Improvements to the translations. (Thank you to the community for helping).

Bug fixes:

 - Fixed a bug where the tutorial didn't count upgrades if done before reaching the upgrade step.
 - Fixed a bug where no sound was made when clicking the Select tool mode buttons.
 - Fixed a bug that would make the game crash when a resource entered a Transporter Output.
 - Fixed a bug where the player could switch between Select tool modes while moving machines, which allowed them to copy machines even if they didn't have enough money.

Thank you for playing the game, more updates to the game are coming. If you would like to join the community, feel free to join our Discord server:

https://discord.gg/guY3fjcXVe
